scenes.text: One double-tap on Pay, and a hundred-dollar wallet spent a hundred and sixty. Claude caught this in your wallet service.
Two requests, same moment. Both read a hundred. Both subtract eighty, and both write back twenty.
The second write overwrites the first. Two charges, but the balance only dropped once. That's a lost update.
Claude's fix: select for update. Request A locks the wallet row, so B has to wait. Then B reads twenty, and gets declined.
Plus an idempotency key, so a retried tap can't charge twice. Read, then write? Lock the row first.
